title: 第11章 大开杀戒第12章 幕后黑手现身
slug: 成为女帝炉鼎我踏上了无敌路
content_zh:
“小易，小凡，快走，别管我们。”
李长青听到大长老李长宏的话语，得知李易和李凡来到了这里，心中焦急，连忙大喊，自己死不足惜，可不能让李族最后的希望也死在这里，那李族就彻底完了。
“逃？我们这里这么多人，别说李易这畜生只有炼气三层，就算达到元府境大圆满，也插翅难逃。”
大长老一脸狞笑，眼里满是杀气，迅速朝李易逼近。
这一战他准备充分，已是胜券在握。
周围，三大族长和一些长老围拢过来，既然选择了这一场伏击行动，那就一不做二不休，赶尽杀绝，以除后患。
“我们四大家族好像没有血海深仇吧，我很想知道，你们为何要听李长宏的话，一起围杀我李族？”
李易神色淡然，一脸好奇。
三大族长对视一眼，想到那个黑衣人的警告，心中发寒，不敢说出半点信息。
“你下了地狱，自会知晓。”
大长老腾跃而起，手持一把上品灵器短剑，激射出璀璨的真气，向李易和李凡两兄弟横扫而来。
他并未因为李易的修为暴跌而轻视。
毕竟前不久自己的天才孙儿李天，一个先天境大圆满的天才，还拥有上品灵器，却被李易一击杀死，这说明对方的肉身极为强大。
“哥，这个叛徒交给我吧。”
李凡修行太一吞天诀后，信心大增，面对昔日需要仰望的大长老，没有丝毫怯意，反而跃跃欲试。
“小凡，你战斗经验太少，他交给我，五长老李长坤留给你。”
李易望着犹若惊鸿一般杀来的大长老，主动迎了过去，他的身法如鬼魅，轻易避开了对方的真气扫荡，来到附近。
随后。
他在漫天飞扬的碎石断木中，借力冲向大长老。
“先天罡气。”

大长老神色微变，没想到李易的身法如此强大且诡异，能避开自己所有的攻击，当即使出玄级中等的防御术，肉身表面形成一层薄薄的罡气，防备被李易近身突袭。
“破！”
李易轻喝一声，手中握着击毙李天后得到的灵器小刀，以体内真气激发而出。
“哧。”
小刀化为一道流光，刺破先天罡气，准确无误地刺入了大长老的咽喉。
“噗。”
大长老眼睛圆瞪，捂住断裂的咽喉，嘴里喷出鲜血，难以置信道：“你何时恢复到先天境的？”
“就在今天早上。”
李易淡淡一笑，嘲讽道：“你若早点出手，也许死的就是我了。”
“李易，你杀了我又如何，你也活不长，我会在黄泉路上等你……”
大长老嘴里吐着血，说着怨毒的话语，然后栽倒在地，死了。
这一幕彻底惊呆了周围的人，他们一脸骇然，一名元府境后期的强者就这样被杀了？而且对手只是一名先天境修士！
这也太可怕了！
“现在该送你们上路了。”
李易扫视三名族长和一众长老，眼中杀意弥漫，李族人的血不能白流，命不能白给，这群伏击的人必须付出代价。
“一起上，杀死李易。”
content_en:
"Xiao Yi, Xiao Fan, leave quickly and leave us alone."
Li Changqing heard the words of the great elder Li Changhong and learned that Li Yi and Li Fan had arrived here. He was anxious and shouted that it was not a pity to die. He could not let the last hope of the Li clan die here, then the Li clan would be completely finished.
"Escape? There are so many of us here, not to mention that this beast Li Yi only has the third level of Qi Refining. Even if he reaches the Yuanfu Realm of Great Perfection, he still cannot escape with his wings."
The great elder had a ferocious smile on his face, his eyes full of murderous intent, and he quickly approached Li Yi.
He was fully prepared for this battle and was sure of victory.
Around them, the three chiefs of the clan and some elders gathered around. Since they had chosen this ambush operation, they would not stop doing anything to kill them all to eliminate future troubles.
"It seems that our four major families don't have any blood feud. I really want to know why you listened to Li Changhong and surrounded and killed my Li family together?"
Li Yi looked calm and curious.
The three patriarchs looked at each other, thinking of the warning of the man in black, their hearts trembled, and they did not dare to tell any information.
"You will know it when you go to hell."
The great elder leaped up, holding a high-grade spiritual weapon dagger, shooting out brilliant infuriating energy, and swept towards the two brothers Li Yi and Li Fan.
He did not despise Li Yi because of his plummeting cultivation level.
After all, not long ago, his genius grandson Li Tian, ​​a genius who reached the Great Perfection of the Innate Realm and possessed a high-grade spiritual weapon, was killed by Li Yi with one blow. This shows that the opponent's physical body is extremely powerful.
"Brother, leave this traitor to me."
After Li Fan practiced the Taiyi Swallowing Heaven Technique, his confidence greatly increased. When facing the great elder who he had to look up to in the past, he did not feel timid at all, but was eager to give it a try.
"Xiao Fan, you have too little combat experience. Leave him to me, and Fifth Elder Li Changkun will leave it to you."
Li Yi looked at the great elder who was coming towards him like a giant, and took the initiative to greet him. His movement was like a ghost, easily avoiding the opponent's true energy sweep and arriving nearby.
Subsequently.
He used his strength to rush toward the great elder amid the debris and broken trees flying in the sky.
"Innate Qi."
The great elder's expression changed slightly. He didn't expect that Li Yi's body skills were so powerful and strange that he could evade all his attacks. Even if he used medium-level defensive skills at the Xuan level, a thin layer of Gang Qi formed on the surface of his body to prevent Li Yi from being attacked at close range.
"Broken!"
Li Yi shouted softly, holding the spiritual weapon knife obtained after killing Li Tianhou in his hand, and stimulated it with the true energy in his body.
"Chi."
The knife turned into a stream of light, pierced the innate Qi, and stabbed into the great elder's throat accurately.
"Pfft."
The great elder's eyes widened, he covered his broken throat, blood spurted out of his mouth, and said in disbelief: "When did you return to the innate state?"
"Just this morning."
Li Yi smiled faintly and said mockingly: "If you had taken action earlier, maybe I would be the one who died."
"Li Yi, it doesn't matter if you kill me, you won't live long. I will wait for you on the road to hell..."
The great elder vomited blood from his mouth and said hateful words, then fell to the ground and died.
This scene completely shocked the people around them. They looked horrified. A strong man in the late Yuanfu realm was killed like this? And the opponent is just a Xiantian realm monk!
This is too terrible!
"Now it's time to send you on your way."
Li Yi glanced at the three clan leaders and the elders, his eyes full of killing intent. The blood of the Li clan cannot be shed in vain, and their lives cannot be given in vain. This group of ambushers must pay the price.
"Come together and kill Li Yi."
